catalog: USGS ANSS ComCat preferred event parameters, all contributing networks; eventtype earthquake
local_filter: 32 <= latitude <= 42; -125 <= longitude <= -114; -100 <= depth_km <= 1000; preferred magnitude >= 4.0; 2017-01-01T00:00:00Z <= origin time < 2019-01-01T00:00:00Z; event type earthquake
horizon: one non-overlapping UTC calendar day; Y=1 iff at least one retained catalog event occurs that day
baseline: fit lambda = calibration event count / 365 days once; p = -expm1(-lambda); same p on all test days; no test refit
loss: mean Brier (p-Y)^2 and mean negative natural-log Bernoulli score; for log score only clip p to [1e-12, 1-1e-12]; lower is better; no threshold selection
calibration_report: one occupied reliability bin per constant model, predicted p, observed occurrence frequency and observed-minus-p; do not manufacture a multi-bin curve
alarm_diagnostic: threshold p>=0.5 fixed; alarm-day rate, false positive rate among no-event days and missed event-day rate. Not an operational alarm. Lead time NOT_APPLICABLE; region rectangle only, no spatial subcell transfer.

uncertainty.method: circular moving-block bootstrap of 2018 daily records conditional on fixed calibration estimates; percentile 2.5/97.5; descriptive only
uncertainty.limitations: not independent event validation; 30 days may not cover all dependence; one test year and nonstationarity limit interval validity; calibration-parameter uncertainty not included

diagnostics: 2017/2018 event counts, active days, days with multiple events, sample variance/mean of daily counts, lag-1 occurrence autocorrelation
monthly counts/active-day rates, without fitting or selecting by month
network and magnitude-type counts; missing ancillary-field counts; count endpoint consistency
data_integrity: retain byte-exact raw CSV and SHA256. Validate nonempty unique event IDs and finite time/lat/lon/depth/mag. Fail on malformed required fields or duplicate IDs, 20000 rows or larger, empty calibration catalog, or incomplete retrieval; no imputation. Exclude endtime boundary event locally and report exclusions. Missing optional fields audited. Zero-filled days mean no recorded matching event, not certified absence.
controls: hand-calculated score case Y=[0,1],p=.5 gives Brier .25/log loss ln2
Poisson rate/occurrence conversion and event-count versus active-day distinction
UTC midnight, split boundary, end-exclusive boundary, exact magnitude/spatial bounds
reject duplicate ID, missing/nonfinite required values
intentional wrong zero-output evaluator fails positive fixture
acceptance: Reproducible byte-hashed real-catalog baseline with all frozen metrics, controls and independent review. No requirement for favorable scores; failed or blocked retrieval is valid negative deliverable. EARTH-003 remains OPEN. No novel predictor or transfer claim.
caveats: Magnitude completeness at M4 is not established for this rectangle/year/network mix; aftershock detection may be incomplete.
Preferred magnitude scales differ; no conversion to common Mw. Position and magnitude uncertainty can shift threshold membership.
Current retrospective catalog can include revisions unavailable in 2017/2018. This is not vintage data or a prospective forecast.
Aftershock dependence and nonstationarity remain; Poisson assumption is a baseline, not accepted physics. Adjacent years and days are not independent replications.
No ground-motion prediction, real-time warning, causal mechanism or personal disaster guidance.
fallback: If catalog cannot be retrieved legally/reliably, record blocked data access; at most run clearly labeled synthetic evaluator unit fixtures with no empirical score claim.
public_claim_status: Claim published by coordinator with explicit new user approval: https://github.com/lijiabao1998/FrontierEarth/issues/3 at 2026-10-09T11:03:47Z; prior denied attempts preserved.
